description: Subscribe a Stripe customer (cus_…) to a price (price_…), optional quantity and trialDays. THIS CHARGES THE CUSTOMER'S SAVED PAYMENT METHOD when there is no trial, so it ALWAYS needs confirm:true (test keys included) after you show the user exactly what will be created. Read back; an INCOMPLETE status means no chargeable card is on file. Needs Stripe connected (Connectors > Stripe, or connect_connector).

confirm.description: true to charge the saved card; always required, test keys included

metadata.description: key/value metadata stored on the subscription

quantity.description: quantity of the price, e.g. number of seats

trialDays.description: free trial length in days before the first charge

name: create_stripe_subscription
title: create stripe subscription
